# s3cmd and its complete runtime dependency set, installed by ./action.yml with
#   pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: -r requirements.txt
# Every entry is a universal wheel pinned by version and SHA-256 (values from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json). --no-deps means nothing outside this
# file is installed, so a new dependency of a bumped version has to be added here.

    --hash=sha256:13ad8a44d44cc0535ba8c878c91fd68cd830dc48f6388722fa44a7aaf3f18017
